_comment: Machine-readable Figma<->code<->token contract (Track B / Method A). The SINGLE source of truth the figmaRegistryParity gate reads. Rebuilt 2026-06-23 from wiki/brand/figma-node-map.md + LIVE Figma audit (file iSQhAVM7SI4QHAWB7y9C2z; themes 69:2, proto 403:2, slides 324:2 verified exact). The SPA never calls Figma at runtime; the components are CANON, mirrored into the code renderers + figma-tokens.json. RE-PULL tokens + re-verify when the Figma library changes.

_templateMap._comment: firstClass: deliverable -> renderer template, each backed by a real Figma component (see figmaNodes). Every entry MUST exist in the types.ts SlideTemplate union + a slideToStageHtml dispatch case + a payload-contract entry. variants: dense/predicate-routed deliverable -> its base firstClass template.

renderer_only._comment: Renderer templates with NO Figma component. They must NEVER masquerade as Figma-grounded. decision drives remediation; alias = the Figma-backed template they should route to until deprecated.

theme-cluster.reason: Figma themes page 69:2 defines overview/theme-detail/theme-arc/theme-mosaic. There is NO theme-cluster component. This renderer-invented layout only wears the brand tokens.

theme-spotlight.reason: Same as theme-cluster: no Figma theme-spotlight component on 69:2.

planned_renderers._comment: Figma components that exist but have no renderer twin YET (reverse gap). Building the twin moves it from here into firstClass; the gate forces union+dispatch+payload at that point. EMPTY as of 2026-06-23: theme-overview (590:9) + theme-detail (590:11) twins were built and promoted to firstClass.

figmaNodes._comment: Node-anchoring (was missing). NXT component node id(s) + NU mode-535:0 twin(s) + page, from the live audit. Enables drift detection + targeted get_design_context re-pulls.

executive-brief.note: RAW FRAME, not componentized; masthead 367:2 is literal text (won't NU-flip). Componentize.

section-divider.note: Shares the canonical slides section-divider symbol (609:4); the GOLD renderer mirrors it.

_slideArchetypes._comment: The slides-system deck archetypes (Figma page 324:2, symbols 609:2..609:15). Rendered by services/slideComposer.ts composeSlide() (the slides: namespace), NOT the GOLD dispatch. 'present' == implemented in ARCHETYPE_SPECS (archetypeKeys()). All 14 verified present 2026-06-23 (migration complete); missing_renderers empty.
